steps.objective: Design REST API contracts (OpenAPI 3.0) for bookmark CRUD, tag listing, and search. Define SQLite schema for bookmarks and tags tables with many-to-many relationship. Design React component tree (BookmarkGrid, BookmarkCard, BookmarkForm, TagSidebar, SearchBar).
acceptance_criteria: OpenAPI spec covers all 7 endpoints from acceptance criteria
SQLite schema defines bookmarks and tags tables with junction table
Component tree shows all 5 required React components with props

steps.objective: Implement SQLite database setup (auto-create tables on startup), bookmark models, CRUD endpoints (POST, GET list, GET detail, PATCH, DELETE), tag endpoints (GET with counts), search (title + description), and URL title/favicon auto-fetcher with 3s timeout.
constraints: Follow OpenAPI contracts from architect step
acceptance_criteria: POST /api/v1/bookmarks creates bookmark with URL, title, description, tags
GET /api/v1/bookmarks returns paginated list with default 20
GET /api/v1/bookmarks?tag=X and ?q=Y filtering works
PATCH and DELETE endpoints work correctly
GET /api/v1/tags returns tags with bookmark counts
URL title auto-fetch with 3s timeout and graceful fallback

steps.objective: Build React components: BookmarkGrid (card-based grid layout), BookmarkCard (title, URL, tags, favicon), BookmarkForm (add/edit with URL validation), TagSidebar (tag list with counts, click to filter), SearchBar (real-time search). Wire up to backend API.
constraints: Use fetch() directly — no state management library
Clean, modern UI with CSS modules or Tailwind
Follow component tree from architect step
acceptance_criteria: BookmarkGrid renders cards with title, URL, tags, favicon
TagSidebar shows tag list with counts, click filters grid
SearchBar filters bookmarks by title/description
BookmarkForm validates URL format before submit
Add and edit bookmark flows work end-to-end

steps.objective: Write unit tests for API endpoints (CRUD operations, search, tag filtering, pagination, edge cases) and component tests for React components (rendering, user interactions, form validation).
constraints: Use in-memory SQLite for test isolation
Cover CRUD + search + pagination + edge cases
acceptance_criteria: Tests cover all CRUD operations
Tests cover search and tag filtering
Tests cover pagination edge cases (empty, last page)
Tests cover URL fetcher timeout and fallback
All tests pass

steps.objective: Review input validation (SQL injection prevention via parameterized queries), URL fetching safety (SSRF prevention, timeout enforcement), and general endpoint security (input sanitization, error information leakage).
constraints: Read-only review — patch only simple findings
Focus: SQL injection, SSRF, input validation
acceptance_criteria: No SQL injection vulnerabilities (parameterized queries verified)
URL fetcher has SSRF protections (timeout, no internal URLs)
Input validation present on all endpoints

steps.objective: Write API documentation page covering all endpoints with request/response examples. Update CHANGELOG with new feature entry.
constraints: Include curl examples for each endpoint
Document query parameters (tag, q, page, per_page)
acceptance_criteria: API docs cover all 7 endpoints with examples
Query parameters documented with examples
CHANGELOG updated with feature entry

dependencies.reason: Backend implements API contracts designed by architect
Frontend follows component tree designed by architect
QA tests require both backend and frontend complete
